requirements.technical_report: 11-page PDF with problem, literature/context, methods, rationale/contribution, positive/negative results, critical evaluation, insights, references and reproducibility record
requirements.documented_source: README, dependency list, commented preparation/model/analysis code and step-by-step commands
requirements.runnable_example: fresh ZIP extraction ran the actual toy pipeline; 240 finite results covering six arms and two evaluations
requirements.toy_data: six included synthetic CSVs, clearly distinguished from the real findings
requirements.raw_data_link: official DepMap portal and recorded release link, exact six filenames, SHA-256 checksums and build instructions

verification.real_model_rerun: 40 targets x six arms x two schemes; close numerical agreement, archived folds used
verification.saved_prediction_scores: 3924 scores reconstructed from main lineage/fusion predictions; maximum discrepancy about 2.01e-6

scope: Audits the stated deliverables; no promise of grade, full-experiment retraining or clinical validation.
